facts.fact: On 2020-03-10, Olah, Cammarata, and coauthors wrote that the typical neuron is understandable, and in the same article that polysemantic neurons responding to unrelated inputs are a major limit on reasoning about networks.
On 2022-09-21, Elhage and coauthors submitted a paper whose abstract says networks often pack many unrelated concepts into a single neuron and models that packing as superposition.

In the 2023 arXiv preprint 2309.08600, Cunningham and coauthors treat polysemantic neurons as a roadblock and present sparse autoencoders, rather than the neurons themselves, as a way to resolve superposition.
On 2026-10-30 the Goodfire essay was revised to weaken the claim that InceptionV1 neuron 4e:55 is simply a V-shape neuron, while still arguing it is not an arbitrary mixture.

The same essay, still presented as a working hypothesis, reports a preliminary Qwen3-32B audit of about 90% of neuron poles with one main job, about 7% with two related jobs, and about 2–4% not yet understood, and says a technical companion paper will cover the language-model experiments.

In the essay’s “On the Title” section the authors say they are maybe 85% sure of a change in kind of learning process, that the title overstates the evidence because they have not audited everything, and that a cleanliness score is the part they are least sure of.

On 2026-10-20 Liv Gorton wrote that her replications of the essay’s experiments disagreed with the reported results and that the canonical cat-and-car and car-circuit cases did not survive what she called basic checks.

On 2026-10-19 Andriy Batutin reported that an LLM labeller tagged 84% of untrained random-init Qwen3 neurons as having one job, versus 52% of trained neurons on Qwen3-0.6B and 1.7B, and that 0 of 299 trained neurons met his pre-registered simulation bar.

On 2026-10-28 a Web of Trust post quoted Cammarata defining “already clean” as parts built to be read by downstream readers, and said its own causal reading of the flower neuron was not a measurement of that neuron.

On 2026-11-05 the Heliox podcast episode “Already Clean” restated the Goodfire essay as the researcher who helped tell the tangled-neuron story asking the field to look again; it announced no new experiment or paper date.

In the Goodfire essay’s text as revised by 2026-10-30, a held-out check on 183 Qwen3-32B gallery neurons found agent-written examples from the explanation alone fired strongly 76% of the time, near misses 11% of the time, and maximally distant concepts about 1% of the time, with 179 of 183 neurons never firing on those distant texts.

In the same revised essay, a re-audit of GPT-2 XL with 500 neuron papers found about 70% looking like roughly one thing, against fewer than 2% called clean in the 2023 automated-interpretability project on that model, while about 5% were called pristine.

On 2026-10-19 Cammarata told MIT Technology Review that he had mapped out whole circuitry after expecting very little to be legible, and that his guess was that things would turn out well because the network was in some sense designed to be read.

On 2025-11-20 Transluce reported that, in Llama 3.1-8B-Instruct, circuits built from MLP neurons were as sparse and faithful as circuits built from sparse-autoencoder features, while stating that learned bases may still be more monosemantic.

On 2026-10-20 Evidence Press recounted Goodfire’s published gallery labels and found “one idea” plus “branching structure” on 86 of 100 sampled Qwen3-32B poles and 83 of 100 sampled expert-model poles, and reported a TinyStories deletion check in which removing the weakest 75% of activations raised loss by 0.037 versus 2.030 for the strongest 3.2%.

uncertainties: The technical companion paper has no published release date before 2026-11-15, so the language-model audits, including Qwen3-32B and Kimi K3, remain unaudited by an independent paper.
Whether the judge treats the 2026-10-30 softening of the V-shape claim, Gorton’s failed checks, and Batutin’s noise baseline as enough to reject the title.
Batutin tested Qwen3-0.6B and 1.7B, not the essay’s Qwen3-32B, so a matching control on 32B could still differ.
No public schedule shows whether Cammarata will post the fuller 4e:55 study before 2026-11-15.
No companion technical paper had appeared by 2026-11-06, so the language-model audit method and sampling frame are still unpublished.
The gallery scores are an AI reviewer’s judgments, and Evidence Press did not re-judge any neuron or rerun the model.
